sources.snippet: GGUF quantization of hotdogs/Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated — the training-free abliterated (refusal-removed) build of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B — converted for llama.cpp / LM Studio / Ollama / vLLM with the MTP (Multi-Token Prediction) head preserved. Status: testing / development. This is an early GGUF upload for evaluation.

sources.snippet: About the source model hotdogs/Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated is a training-free abliterated build of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (a dense 27B native vision-language model with hybrid full-attention + linear-attention architecture). Refusal behaviour is removed by a single forward-only rank-1 weight edit that orthogonalizes the "refusal direction" out of the 131 residual-stream writers — no fine-tuning, no ...
